name: mirandrom__pys2
behavioral_change: pydantic v_old 1.8.1 to v_new 2.11.7 (v_old is a resolved value for this TimeMachine-bench snapshot). In pydantic v2, an Optional[X] field declared on a BaseModel without an explicit default is no longer implicitly defaulted to None; it is treated as a required field (root API: pydantic.BaseModel field declaration and instantiation, root symbols ModelField._type_analysis and FieldInfo.is_required).
downstream_effect: Instantiating the downstream project's models fails at runtime because fields that previously defaulted to None are now required; the field declarations themselves still import and load without error.
reference_fix: The reference fix adds an explicit = None default to about 90 Optional[X] field declarations.

upgrade.note: TimeMachine-bench case: every dependency is resolved at the dated snapshot; the library at v_old/v_new is the one whose behavioral change breaks the tests.
